title: senecio jacobaea subsp. lycopifolius
intro: Senecio jacobaea subsp. lycopifolius, commonly known as ragwort fern, is a subspecies of the Senecio jacobaea plant, a biennial herb native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Senecio jacobaea subsp. lycopifolius include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and show potential in cancer treatment. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
